_comment: The plan. Paths are relative to this directory. `sections` are the script's `## N.` sections:
{file, scene, extra_seconds?, ambience?, params?, hold_seconds?} records file?scene=N for the section's
span in the narration plus extra_seconds; {video, slate_seconds?} is your own clip with its audio.
dips: [from, to] boundaries that get a dip-to-black (video only); everything else is a straight cut.
hold_seconds is legal only on the last narrated section. mix.* and soundscape.* are optional.
